test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is 'dries'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The most appropriate answer is 'dries'.
 
• The meaning of the word 'dries' is '**to **become dry'.
 
• Hence, the appropriate word to fill in the blank is 'dries'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• Soaks- make or allow (something) to become thoroughly wet by immersing it in liquid.

 
 
• Wipes- clean or dry (something) by rubbing with a cloth, a piece of paper, or one's hand.
 
• Dehydrates- lose a large amount of water from the body.
